Public work / Drawings & Renderings

Riffle Mode

Material
Aluminum truss skinned with riffle strips
Status
Rendering, not built

Rendered models of sculptures made in LineWorks, with the path generated from streamflow data and skinned in layered strips. Shown placed in photographs of roundabouts, then as the model alone. Not built.
